description: This Python script processes JSON data related to device support documentation, including parsing, bit manipulation, and generating configuration output files.

methods.name: supported_docs
methods.description: Processes individual subdocuments to determine support and version info.

methods.name: supplementary_docs
methods.description: Adds supplementary document names to a global list.

methods.name: bit_position
methods.description: Populates the bit position map with support info.

methods.name: decimal_converter
methods.description: Converts bit positions to version values and supports version tracking.

methods.name: bit_calc
methods.description: Calculates binary bit values based on bit positions.

methods.name: append_bit
methods.description: Appends group ID nibble to version bits.

methods.name: local_main
methods.description: Loads JSON input and initiates parsing.

methods.name: json_read
methods.description: Parses JSON data for device support info and generates output configuration file.
